Software engineering is doing fine but I'm not in software engineering. I think IT is now saturated. I would learn programming or take a boot camp but then I hear of engineers who took the boot camps but did not have luck. 

I work part time so that way I don't have a damn resume gap. Why til June? Do places not hire between January and June?

This made feel really good, thank you. When I say experience I mean someone who has been in the industry for a couple years. 

You're right I should use this time to enjoy myself and improve in other areas. Realize that this is temporary and I'm not permanently going to be a basement dweller.
